description: List the links on the account the API key belongs to: short links, link-in-bio pages and restaurant menus, with their click counts. Filter by type or by a search term, and sort by newest or by most clicked. Requires a ShareCut API key (Business plan).

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging. Default 0.

q.description: Match against short code, title, description and destination.

sort.description: Newest first (default) or most clicked first.

name: list_links
title: List links
